email_subject: Application - Technical Integration Specialist at Constructor
email_body:
Dear Constructor Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Technical Integration Specialist role. Your AI-first approach to ecommerce search matches how I work: combining technical implementation with a clear focus on measurable outcomes.

In my current roles, I integrate websites and platforms with search and analytics tools, advise on structured data and index architecture, and translate technical concepts for clients. At Episto, I manage CMS content and SEO for ecommerce clients, including Shopify stores where I maintain product catalogues and optimise on-page elements. Freelance, I built and optimised mirook.com with JSON-LD schema and llms.txt, and ran technical audits that improved search health. My front-end background (AngularJS, JavaScript) and daily use of AI tools for debugging and documentation give me a practical edge in guiding engineering teams.

I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can help Constructor's customers achieve successful integrations.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Constructor Hiring Team,

I'm excited to apply for the Technical Integration Specialist position. Constructor's AI-first ecommerce search platform aligns perfectly with my experience at the intersection of technical implementation and digital marketing. I've spent the past years helping businesses integrate systems, optimise product data, and improve search visibility—exactly the kind of work this role demands.

In my current position at Episto, I work on client websites including ecommerce stores on Shopify, where I manage product catalogues, implement structured data, and ensure on-page SEO best practices. I regularly advise on technical approaches for integrating analytics and search tools, and I translate complex concepts into clear guidance for clients. Freelance projects like mirook.com have given me hands-on experience with JSON-LD schema, knowledge-graph markup, and llms.txt—directly relevant to index architecture and structured data. My front-end development background (AngularJS, JavaScript) and daily use of AI tools for debugging and documentation further strengthen my ability to support engineering teams.

What draws me to Constructor is the opportunity to serve as a technical advisor, helping customers navigate integration decisions and achieve high-quality outcomes. I'm detail-oriented, consultative in my problem-solving, and passionate about making complex technical concepts accessible. I'm confident that my mix of customer-facing technical work and ecommerce search expertise would allow me to contribute meaningfully to your team.

I'd love the opportunity to discuss how my skills can help Constructor's customers succeed.

Best regards,
